name: customer-experience

frames.best_why: A large photo floats over the list while the category rows and descriptions stay readable beside it.
frames.render_note: Left edge is cropped: the title shows only "XPERIENCE" and the row arrows are cut.

tagline: A photo index where a picture springs along with the pointer.
summary: A peach page with a giant orange EXPERIENCE title over a list of photo categories. Each row pairs an arrow and label with a right-aligned description, and hovering any row releases a floating photo that follows the cursor.
appearance: Warm peach background with a very large orange uppercase title above a stack of rows divided by thin orange rules. Each row has a diagonal orange arrow, a bold category name with a small grey subtitle on the left, and a grey paragraph on the right. A rounded photo drifts over the list.
behaviour: Moving the pointer onto a row fades in that row's photograph and it springs after the cursor across the page. Leaving the row fades the photo out again, and the list itself never moves.
demo_content: Categories like Urban Landscapes, Nature Portraits, Abstract Art and Fashion Editorial with photo blurbs.
search_phrases: floating image that follows the cursor
gallery links that show a photo
use_when: A photography or portfolio index wants a text list where hovering each entry previews its photo under the cursor.
avoid_when: The preview needs a mouse, so touch and keyboard users only get the text, and every image URL is fixed.
customise: Eight photo rows with labels, subtitles, paragraphs and image URLs are hardcoded; the peach palette and preview size need source edits.
weight_why: Eight text rows and one spring-following image that idles when the pointer stops.

a11y.note: Rows are plain divs with mouse-only handlers, so the photo preview cannot be reached by keyboard or touch; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The frames crop the left edge, cutting the title to "XPERIENCE" and partly hiding the row arrows.
While following the pointer the photo covers labels and descriptions underneath it.
polish_why: Bold warm editorial index with a lively spring preview; the oversized title is clipped in frames.
